---
title: Late record notes
description: Add a short record note to an eligible model request and read its submission disposition.
---

Set `lateRecordNotes: true` in `Agent.create()` to put a short note at the end
of an eligible model request. The option is off by default. The note can name
open coverage points, limits the library recorded, and tool call outcomes.
It draws on facts already recorded in the current turn. It carries an
attribution line that identifies it as framework-supplied data and stays out
of conversation history.

## Enable late record notes

The first supported route is library-owned `openai()` using the default OpenAI
Chat Completions endpoint. Injected clients and unresolved routes keep the
ordinary request. The library preserves the request bytes on signing-capable
routes and bound continuations.

<CodeFile

The [runnable example](https://github.com/footprintjs/agentfootprint/blob/main/examples/features/131-late-record-notes.ts)
uses an injected, scripted client with synthetic data and runs offline. It checks
that the follow-up ends with the tool result and that the receipt says
`unavailable`. The receipt has no accepted note attempt.

## Read the receipt

Read `lateRecordNoteReceipt` from `agent.getLastSnapshot()?.sharedState`.
The optional one-element array holds the latest recorded call's receipt.
`attempts` contains bounded per-call attempt ordinals and their dispositions.
`accepted`, when present, identifies the attempt that produced the selected
response.

- `submitted` means the owned encoder handed the exact note to the SDK.
- `omitted` means the library observed a handoff without the note.
- `not-dispatched` means the library observed an abort before handoff.
- `unavailable` means the library lacked sufficient handoff evidence.

Remote receipt, model use and improved answers remain unverified. The receipt
exposes dispositions and ordinals. Note text and private proof values are
kept out of the receipt. `servedAt()` exposes the accepted disposition and its
record pointer for the selected call. A served recording does not reproduce
the note text.
